sourceLines: //! @yah:ticket(R020-T17, "POST/DELETE /ownership HTTP routes (cheers-axum)")
//! @yah:assignee(agent:claude)
//! @yah:status(review)
//! @yah:phase(P2)
//! @yah:parent(R020)

//! @yah:next("Add cheers_axum::ownership module: OwnershipState<V, O> bundling the McpClaims verifier (V) + an Arc<O: OwnershipStore>, plus a router() that mounts POST /ownership and DELETE /ownership/<id>.")

//! @yah:next("POST /ownership: extract McpClaims, require Scope::OwnershipWrite, deserialize { principal_id, resource_kind, resource_id, relationship, on_behalf_of }, set granted_by = claims.sub, call OwnershipStore::insert; return 201 + Json(OwnershipRow).")
//! @yah:next("DELETE /ownership/<id>: extract McpClaims, require Scope::OwnershipWrite, call revoke_by_id(now()); 204 on success, 404 on StoreError::NotFound.")

//! @yah:next("Integration test: round-trip via tower::Service::call — mint a v4.public token bearing ownership:write → POST → 200 OwnershipRow → DELETE → 204 → OwnershipStore::get shows revoked_at set.")
//! @yah:verify("cargo test -p cheers-axum (round-trip POST → DELETE → store::get shows revoked_at).")
//! @yah:verify("Negative: a token without Scope::OwnershipWrite is rejected with 401/403 before any store side-effect (assert by inspecting OwnershipStore call count or a stub impl).")
//! @yah:verify("Negative: POSTing a row with on_behalf_of NOT LIKE 'user:%' is rejected by NewOwnership::new() and surfaces as a 4xx (not a 500).")

//! @yah:gotcha("The grant API rejects (kind=User, scope=ownership:write) at write time — the mint path is a defense-in-depth check, not the primary one. This ticket is on the mint-side; the grant-side check already lives in cheers_core::validate_grant (R020-F3).")
//! @yah:depends_on(R020-T16)
//! @yah:depends_on(R020-F4)

//! @yah:handoff("Landed crates/cheers-axum/src/ownership.rs (re-exported as cheers_axum::ownership::*): OwnershipState<O> { mcp: Arc<McpAuthState>, store: Arc<O: OwnershipStore> }, router<O>() mounting POST /ownership + DELETE /ownership/{id}, plus the create/revoke handlers. State is non-generic over the verifier for the same reason T16 was — McpAuthState wraps a concrete PasetoV4PublicVerifier today; when McpAuthState genericizes (alongside an McpTokenVerifier trait, likely R020-F11) this state inherits the change as a one-liner.")

//! @yah:handoff("POST /ownership uses a separate CreateOwnershipBody (granted_by intentionally absent from the wire — handler fills it from the verified claims.sub so a caller can't impersonate another service principal). The wire body is { principal_id, resource_kind, resource_id, relationship, on_behalf_of? }. Handler: authenticate_mcp → require_scope(OwnershipWrite) → NewOwnership::new(...) → store.insert(now). Returns 201 + Json(OwnershipRow).")

//! @yah:handoff("DELETE /ownership/{id} extracts claims, requires OwnershipWrite, calls revoke_by_id(now). 204 on success. Added a dedicated map_store_error that maps StoreError::NotFound → RouteError::UnknownOwnership (404, code unknown_ownership) — the generic From<StoreError> bridge stays as 500 Store fallback for other variants. Mirrors me.rs's map_authority_error pattern.")

//! @yah:handoff("RouteError grew TWO new variants: OwnershipInvalid(#[from] OwnershipValidationError) → 400 'ownership_invalid' (covers NewOwnership::new failures: GrantedByNotService / OnBehalfOfNotUser), and UnknownOwnership → 404 'unknown_ownership'. Both update status_and_code. The defense-in-depth gotcha on the ticket is satisfied by OwnershipInvalid: even if a User-sub token somehow held ownership:write, NewOwnership::new(granted_by=claims.sub) rejects it at parse time → 400, not a store round trip.")

//! @yah:handoff("MemOwnershipStore lives in tests/common/mod.rs (alongside MemUserStore etc.). Tracks an AtomicUsize insert_call_count so the negative tests can assert 'rejected before any store side-effect' instead of trusting the call shape. Implements the full OwnershipStore trait (insert/get/revoke_by_id/revoke_by_on_behalf_of/list_for_principal) so future tests for cascading revoke don't need a second fixture.")

//! @yah:handoff("7 integration tests in tests/ownership_basic.rs: round_trip_post_then_delete_marks_row_revoked (the canonical verify clause); delete_unknown_id_returns_404 (StoreError::NotFound mapping); post_without_ownership_write_returns_403_before_any_store_call (scope guard + insert_call_count==0); post_missing_bearer_returns_401_before_any_store_call (auth guard + insert_call_count==0); post_with_service_on_behalf_of_is_400_ownership_invalid (NewOwnership::new validation surfaces as 4xx not 500); post_with_user_sub_is_rejected_by_defense_in_depth (User-sub OwnershipWrite token rejected at NewOwnership::new, defense-in-depth gotcha pinned); delete_without_ownership_write_returns_403_before_any_store_call (scope guard runs before revoke_by_id, row stays live). Plus 3 unit tests inside src/ownership.rs covering map_store_error and the OwnershipInvalid→400 IntoResponse path.")

//! @yah:handoff("Verified GREEN: cargo test -p cheers-axum → 22 unit (+3 ownership::tests, was 19) + 7 ownership_basic integration + 7 me_basic + 3 doctests (+1 ownership doctest, was 2); cargo test -p cheers-core/-p cheers-server/-p cheers-verify all clean; cargo check --workspace --all-features clean.")

//! @yah:handoff("Wire shape coordination — the CreateOwnershipBody fields (principal_id, resource_kind, resource_id, relationship, on_behalf_of) and the returned OwnershipRow JSON (with granted_by populated by the handler) are the producer surface yah-side W159 / R427 consumers will write against. Any rename here is a coordinated change. PrincipalId roundtrips as 'kind:id' (e.g. 'svc:yubaba', 'user:alice') verbatim — already pinned by cheers-core principal tests, but worth flagging when the yah kamaji's POST body builder lands.")

//! @yah:next("Sign off → archive R020-T17. The /token mint-side HTTP endpoint (dispatches grant_type → mint_user_fresh / mint_bootstrap / mint_token_exchange) is the natural peer ticket — needs McpAuthority on the state side, not McpAuthState. That's still unticketed; file when R020-F6/F7/F8 mint paths converge.")

//! @yah:next("When McpAuthState becomes generic over McpTokenVerifier (R020-F11 JWKS multi-kid driver), OwnershipState<O> becomes OwnershipState<V, O> in the same one-line change — the handler's authenticate_mcp call site is the only churn.")
//! @yah:verify("cargo test -p cheers-axum --test ownership_basic — all 7 round-trip + negative scenarios pass.")
//! @yah:verify("cargo test -p cheers-axum ownership::tests — 3 unit tests pin map_store_error and the OwnershipInvalid → 400 IntoResponse path.")
//! @yah:verify("cargo test -p cheers-axum && cargo test -p cheers-core && cargo test -p cheers-server && cargo test -p cheers-verify — full workspace verify is clean.")
//! @yah:verify("cargo check --workspace --all-features — no new warnings, no missing-feature regressions.")
